dataset_description.Name: Registered Report of ERN During Three Versions of a Flanker Task

readme_content:
[![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.82901%2Fnemar.on004883-blue)](https://doi.org/10.82901/nemar.on004883)

This study is described at https://osf.io/qt2zh/ and was published here: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/psyp.14607. 

Raw EGI MFF files were imported with EEGLAB, task-specific events were recoded into response-locked and stimulus-locked ERN-relevant event labels, and then exported to BIDS.
